title: Replace a drive-and-motion-control connector in a commercial cleaning robot
objective: Remove a failed motion-control harness connector and install its replacement while preserving surrounding wiring and seals.
success_conditions: Blocked: no defensible success rubric can be written from the acquired sources because they do not identify a cleaning-robot assembly, connector part number, access geometry, removal procedure, insertion procedure, or sealing inspection.
